## UTM string

> _Use one consistent taxonomy so the cross-channel CPM comparison stays accurate. Keep values lowercase._
> _Use `paid_social` for paid social channels (not `paid-social`), and `cpc` for cost-per-click (not `ppc`, `cpa`, or `cplpv`)._

-   **utm_source:** _e.g. meta, reddit, google_
-   **utm_medium:** _e.g. paid_social, cpc_

-   **utm_content:** _the creative variant_
